The plate looks like roughly 22-26 cm across, and it holds two pizza slices. One slice is a cheese pizza triangle about 15 cm on each side. The other is folded or partly eaten and appears to be a calzone-like piece.

Pizza slices of this size, around 1/8 to 1/6 of a large pizza, usually weigh 100-130 g each. For two slices I estimate about 220 g total.

Cheese pizza runs about 270 kcal per 100 g, so 220 g comes to roughly 590 kcal. The slices look thin and somewhat dry, so I'm lowering that to about 550 kcal.
